clips.title: The story
paras: Tonga Runetotem sends you southeast from the Crossroads to search the Stagnant Oasis. He wants to know if the hidden fissure beneath the Forgotten Pools has a match in its murky waters.

Tonga Runetotem sends you to the Stagnant Oasis after a strange fissure is found beneath the Forgotten Pools. He suspects the sudden patches of lush growth across the Barrens have a cause beneath the earth. You search the oasis's murky shallows for another opening, among predators that haunt the water.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Like the one you found at the Forgotten Pools, there may be fissures at the other oases in the Barrens. If so, then perhaps the fissures are the oases' source of life.
Here, take these seeds. They are dead and infertile, but take them to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast. If there is a fissure there, then place the seeds within it...and observe.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been to the Stagnant Oasis? Was there a fissure beneath its waters?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your findings are amazing! The seeds I gave you were dried, and dead. Whatever rests under these oases can create life from nothing!
